how: We read the website of every Chicago wedding videographer listed on Lazo (155 listings, 125 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: DJ companies and planners that also sell video, a national chain's Chicago page, an officiant, and a company that sends you to a separate pricing page per city. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is ceremony audio captured on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera? Lakefront wind eats vows.
What is the delivery timeline for the trailer and the full film, and is raw footage included?
Does the price change if the ceremony is in the city and the reception is in the suburbs?

picks.name: Forever Hello Films
picks.blurb: Amy Lynn has made wedding films since 2015 after twenty-plus years as a fashion photographer and music video director. Chicago-based, booking anywhere, and the site states its numbers: a forever film starts at $5,795 and couples' average investment is $6,795.

picks.name: Matthew Robert Creative
picks.blurb: Started in 2015 by best friends Matthew and Ben, with a portfolio of over 100 weddings across the Midwest and Southern California. Matthew holds a master's in documentary filmmaking from Northern Illinois University, and the packages spell out a five-minute film, multi-camera ceremony and reception edits, and a one-minute trailer a day or two after the wedding.

picks.name: For Love Films
picks.blurb: Formerly NightOwls Media, renamed For Love Films because weddings are the love stories its owner most wants to tell, from church weddings to nerdy, backyard and same-sex celebrations. Based in Chicago, filming worldwide, with photography offered alongside, and an owner who also teaches film production at DePaul.

picks.name: Munaco Pictures
picks.blurb: Tom at Munaco Pictures has filmed more than 500 weddings over 15-plus years and publishes his prices: packages start at $1,599.99, and the most popular option at $2,999.99 covers up to six hours of multi-camera coverage with a next-day teaser.

picks.name: Highway 61 Films
picks.blurb: Highway 61 Films has made cinematic wedding films since 2009 in Chicago and at destinations, editing everything in house. The menu is clear: a feature up to nine minutes delivered in four to six weeks, a two-minute trailer a week after, with speeches reels, ceremony edits, drone footage from licensed pilots and Super 8mm film as options.

picks.name: Lindsay Morgan Wedding Films
picks.blurb: Lindsay started filming weddings over six years ago and shoots documentary-style for about 90 percent of the day, using movement prompts rather than stationary poses for portraits and compact gear so she is not blocking the view. Based in Fox River Grove, covering Chicagoland and southern Wisconsin.

picks.name: Bella Donna Studios
tags: one crew for photo and video
picks.blurb: One coordinated crew for photo and video, so you are not juggling two vendors and two timelines. Bella Donna Studios has worked for over ten years with a roster of 12 photographers and 15 videographers, covering Chicagoland, Southwest Michigan and destinations, with films edited to match the photographs.

picks.name: IG PHOTO VIDEO INC
picks.blurb: A Wheeling team doing candid photos and cinematic films across Chicagoland, Milwaukee, Lake Geneva and Northwest Indiana, with a reach the site says extends to five states. It promises to confirm availability and send the full pricing guide within 12 hours.

picks.name: Windy City Production
picks.blurb: Sam and Katie's Aurora studio shoots cinema as well as photo, including Sam's hybrid solo coverage where one shooter does both crafts with one vision. Films and galleries from their own packages arrive within 14 days, and pricing has lived on its own page since the studio started in 2012.

picks.name: Red Barn Wedding Studio
picks.blurb: Cinematography sits beside photography at this family-owned Des Plaines studio: a full-length film plus a trailer, edited to tell the story of the day. Fifteen years in and 1,000-plus weddings, with a consultation included in every collection.

picks.name: This Is Feeling Photo + Video
picks.blurb: Films from the same documentary collective that shoots the photos, so the two match. The Chicago team says it works calmly in the background, with no upselling, no fluff and coverage tailored to what matters most on the day.

picks.name: Fox + Ivory
picks.blurb: Fox + Ivory's film collections start at $3,700 and can be bundled with its photography under one studio, one timeline and one planning call. The films are pitched as not boring, cheesy or cookie cutter, and raw video footage is on the list of what you receive.
